info.name: Chatwoot API v4.9.1 - Complete Collection
info.description:
Complete API collection for Chatwoot v4.9.1 with AiFocus customizations.

## Total: 51 API Categories

## Authentication

Most endpoints require authentication via API key in the header:
- `api_access_token`: Your user or bot API token

## Base URL
- Production: `https://your-chatwoot-domain.com`
- Development: `http://localhost:3000`

## Variables
Set these in your Postman environment:
- `base_url`: Your Chatwoot instance URL
- `api_access_token`: Your API token
- `account_id`: Your account ID
